# Vendored files

Browser libraries and fonts are copied here. There are no CDNs (strict CSP). When you change a file, update its row. CI fails if a file is unlisted, missing, or its SHA-256 differs.

The game's files (`fonts.css`, `fonts/`, `gsap.min.js`) live in `app/vendor/`; `python3 app/build.py` copies them here and never deletes this file or other vendored files. Change them in `app/vendor/`, rebuild, then update the row. The check also fails if a file in `app/vendor/` differs from its row.

The resume reader's libraries (`pdfjs/`, `mammoth/`) are used only by the adult app (`/work/`) and are loaded only after a person picks a file. They live only here, not in `app/vendor/`; the student build does not touch them. Each was taken unchanged from its npm package (registry.npmjs.org), at a version more than two weeks old on 29 Oct 2026. To update one, download the new package, copy the same files, and change the row.

The on-device skill reader's library (`transformers/`) is used only by the adult app (`/work/`) and is loaded only after a person agrees to the tier 2 reading (BUILD_PLAN T4.5; `app/adult/intake_embed.js` is the only file that imports it). `transformers.min.js` is the self-contained browser bundle of `@huggingface/transformers` 4.3.2 (Apache-2.0; published on npm 2026-10-27, see docs/adult/deviations.md D43 on its age). It includes onnxruntime-web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0, the version that release pins. The two `ort-wasm-simd-threaded` files are that onnxruntime-web package's single-thread WebAssembly runtime (MIT), the plain build and not the 26.9 MB `.asyncify` build, which is over the 25 MiB file limit of Cloudflare Pages. The app points the library at these files and turns off every remote path (`env.allowRemoteModels = false`), so no request leaves this site. The model files are not here: they are fetched at build time, pinned and hash-checked (`app/adult/tools/tier2_model.json`), and served from `/work/models/`. To update: download the new npm packages, copy the same files, change the rows, and re-run the tier 2 tests.

Check by hand: `node .github/scripts/check_vendor_hashes.mjs`
